prose: Comedian Owen Benjamin joins Chance and mystical bodyworker Topher Gardner for a wide-ranging conversation right after Owen's first comedy special in four years and just days after the October 2023 eclipse. Three different lenses on the same big shift happening in human consciousness right now.

In this session: Owen's return to standup and what it took to keep going through four years of being de-platformed, the noble savage as the archetype of someone who lives by their own values rather than the trader's script, the thinking class versus the doing class versus the trader class, the symbolism of the eclipse and the alignment of cultural events around it, manifesting reality through collective focus, energy work and what it really means to project consciousness, the Plato Symposium and the deeper meaning behind ancient ritual roles, and Topher's framework of Biocharisma.
